perf-mouse-hook-dedup-2026-08-05.desc: Deduplicate WH_MOUSE_LL dispatches (skip same-coord events) + cache innerProximityRect to avoid per-mouse-move Rect allocation.

eng-pr-ci-2026-08-04.desc: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml: build+test on every PR and push to master. Auto-discovers *.Tests.csproj.

fix-settings-monitor-workarea-2026-08-04.desc: Fix SettingsWindow_Loaded to use Screen.FromHandle(owner) + DPI scale instead of SystemParameters.WorkArea. Closes #138.

fix-settings-stale-slider-2026-08-03.desc: Fix SettingsWindow_Closing to use actual brightness/color-temp values instead of stale slider values.

improve-appsettings-2026-08-03.desc: Cache JsonSerializerOptions as static readonly + atomic write (temp+rename) in AppSettings.

test-appsettings-v3.desc: 19 xUnit tests for AppSettings (defaults, round-trip, corrupt JSON, trailing commas). Closes #139 #133.

feat-start-with-windows.desc: Add Start with Windows toggle to tray menu; HKCU Run registry entry.

fix-issue-131-color-temp-init.desc: Fix CreateMonitorWindow() gradient stops and drop shadow colour to use _colorTemperature lerp. Closes #131.

fix-persist-control-window-visibility.desc: Persist IsControlWindowVisible in AppSettings; restore on load; save on toggle.

fix-persist-show-all-monitors-v2.desc: Persist showOnAllMonitors in AppSettings; restore on load; save on toggle. Closes #130.

fix-allmonitors-button-feedback-2026-08-.desc: Add toggleAllMonitorsMenuItem + dynamic tooltip on AllMonitorsButton - shows active all-monitors state in tray and control bar.

maintainer_preferences: Prefers bug fixes/functional improvements. Closed refactor PRs. Manually applied RA branches (#65,#67,#69 closed). NOTE: refactor/cleanup PRs may be closed.

known_limitations.pr_creation: PR creation via safeoutputs create_pull_request confirmed working. PRs are filtered by integrity (github-actions[bot] PRs invisible to RA agent). Use branch comparison links.
known_limitations.branch_push: Cannot push branches via git - no git credentials. But safeoutputs push_to_pull_request_branch works for existing PRs.
known_limitations.build: net10.0-windows needs -p:EnableWindowsTargeting=true on both restore and build steps. Test project targets net8.0.
